title: Opportunity to Participate in the UAIR Executive Director Search | University of Arizona News
text:
Opportunity to Participate in the UAIR Executive Director Search
The search committee, led by Kirsten Limesand, vice provost for graduate education and dean of the Graduate College, has identified four finalists for the position of executive director for University Analytics and Institutional Research.
The university community is invited to attend campus presentations for each of the four candidates, at which the candidate will give a short presentation followed by a Q&A session.
All presentations will be held in person in the Marroney Theatre and on Zoom and are open to faculty and staff. See the dates and links to register below.
The names of the finalists will be posted in this Box folder 24 hours before each presentation. We ask that you complete the feedback survey for all four candidates.
Please contact provost@arizona.edu with any questions. Thank you for your participation in this important process.
UAIR Executive Director Search - Candidate Campus Presentations
In Person: Marroney Theatre, 1025 N. Olive Rd.
Candidate A: 1:30 – 2:15 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 30
Candidate B: 1:30 – 2:15 p.m. Monday, Nov. 3
Candidate C: 1:30 – 2:15 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 4
Candidate D: 1:30 – 2:15 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 13
Register for in-person or Zoom
